mechanism: Supertrend (TradingView ta.supertrend, hl2, ATR via RMA; OHLC unadjusted for dividends in the US, adjusted for splits and dividends in TW from 2026-11-08; US ATR 14 / mult 3, TW ATR 14 / mult 2): per leg level = 0.7 x weekly + 0.3 x monthly (long only; weekly W-FRI, monthly calendar month end; a bar counts only after the last weekday of its period has closed) -> 100/70/30/0%, or 50% during a lower-band takeback (from data date 2026-11-06). From data date 2026-11-10 the TW index part also holds 00631L at 20% (0050 weekly Supertrend only: 100 up, 0 down, 30 during its own takeback). No leverage, no execution band: level is already discrete, signal at the close, trade the next trading day in one step. In force from data date 2026-11-04; before that the W52 x adaptive sigma_t rule (cap 1.0 from 2026-10-19, A2 exec layer) applied and history is not rewritten. US keeps the IEF/GLD overlay (defensive rule: supertrend).
status: LIVE main system. Since 2026-11-04: index legs follow Supertrend 70% weekly + 30% monthly (decided 2026-11-04). The previous W52 rule runs on as a control line (w52_state.json), no email. Email on actionable change (a leg's target level differs from the held level, or IEF/GLD overlay change)
leverage: No borrowing: each leg holds level x weight of the index part (US QQQ 70 / SMH 30; TW 0050 50 / 2330 50 before data date 2026-11-10, then 0050 40 / 2330 40 / 00631L 20; level 100/70/30/0, or 50 during a lower-band takeback). 00631L is a 2x fund, so TW stock exposure can reach 120%.
